stories.title: 2 Waymo cars involved in Phoenix crash, injuries reported
stories.summary: The crash occurred near 19th and Van Buren streets and involved at least four vehicles. Surveillance footage shows an oncoming vehicle hitting one of the Waymo cars.

stories.title: No survivors after aircraft goes down near North Rim of Grand Canyon
stories.summary: Multiple people were aboard the aircraft when it went down.

stories.title: Weather Impact Alert for Tuesday in Arizona
stories.summary: Rain and thunderstorms sweep across the state Tuesday morning

stories.title: Mattel Adventure Park at VAI Resort in Glendale is now 'Mattel City'
stories.summary: The VAI Resort in Glendale expands with the creation of Mattel City, including themed hotels and attractions, promising a unique entertainment destination for all.

stories.title: Arizona artist helps children transform U.S.-Mexico border wall into colorful work of art
stories.summary: A Bisbee artist is bringing creativity to the border, helping children in Naco, Mexico, paint murals and discover their love for art.

stories.title: Teens' TikTok stunt leads to bans from multiple West Valley schools
stories.summary: A TikTok stunt by teenagers sneaking into West Valley high schools has led to their ban from multiple districts.

stories.title: Lottery ticket sold in Mesa worth over $690,000
stories.summary: The lucky ticket was purchased at a store in Mesa.

stories.title: Husband, wife arrested on multiple sex crimes against minor in Scottsdale
stories.summary: The suspect was arrested at a hotel in Scottsdale, where he believed he was meeting a 12-year-old girl and her mother, police said.

stories.title: Man killed by stray bullet inside his apartment on Halloween night
stories.summary: Police are asking for the public's help in finding a suspect.

stories.title: Husband pleads guilty to negligent homicide for wife's death in Tempe
stories.summary: Colleen Hoopes, a ballet dancer in the Valley, was shot to death at a Tempe residence in 2022.

stories.title: Arsonist found guilty of murder for Phoenix fire that killed 86-year-old woman
stories.summary: The defendant had been a caregiver for the victim before the deadly fire.

stories.title: Woman, dog killed after being hit by car in Phoenix
stories.summary: According to Phoenix PD, the woman and her dog were walking outside of the crosswalk when they were hit.
